basis.governing_question: How should Seguros Atlântida redesign how its claims department is organized, roles and handoffs included?

sub_questions.question: How is claims work organized today, in roles and handoffs, and where does it break down?
What workload, cost and performance baseline must the target organization improve on?
Which structure, role and governance options for claims are worth comparing, and on what criteria?
How should roles and handoffs work in the chosen target organization?
What transition plan moves claims from today's organization to the target?
What does the executive committee need to see to approve the target organization?

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phase_work.why: One department diagnosed in a single block; one start-up week and one synthesis week frame it. Within the archetype's typical range.

work.unit: Target model for the whole organization (structure, roles, governance)

phase_work.why: Target model first, then transition plan, in sequence since the scope is a single unit; one synthesis week closes the gate.

sizing.levers: Leaving the transition plan to a later engagement would shorten it most, by 1 to 2 weeks.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how claims roles, handoffs and workload run today, and which areas the redesign must address.

gate.label: Design scope decision
gate.decision: Which improvement areas will the target organization design take forward?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target claims organization (roles, handoffs, governance) and its transition plan for executive committee approval.

gate.label: Target model sign-off
gate.decision: Approve the target organization and transition plan for the executive committee?

architect_notes: Engagement length is open: the 11 to 14 weeks are an estimate from the sizing, to be confirmed before quoting.
Design takes 7 to 9 weeks from a 6 to 9 week estimate; a six-week target model with a two-week transition plan reaches 9.
The count of one claims department comes from public research and needs the client's confirmation; more units would lengthen both phases.
